title: Smart Data Models - Gaia-X Ontology - LegalPerson
description: https://w3id.org/gaia-x/2.1.11#class/LegalPerson. A legal person, who is uniquely identified by its registration number. Subclass of Participant per the Gaia-X ontology; inherited properties are documented on the Participant model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'LegalPerson'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

registrationNumber.description: Relationship. Country's registration number, which identifies one specific entity. Valid formats are local, EUID, EORI, vatID, leiCode. Links to one or more RegistrationNumber entities.

legalAddress.description: Relationship. The full legal address of the organization. Links to an Address entity.

headquartersAddress.description: Relationship. Full physical location of the headquarters of the organization. Links to an Address entity.

parentOrganizationOf.description: Relationship. A list of resolvable links to Gaia-X Credentials of participants that this entity is a subOrganization of, if any. Links to one or more LegalPerson entities.

subOrganisationOf.description: Relationship. A list of resolvable links to Gaia-X Credentials of participants with a legal mandate on this entity, e.g. as a subsidiary. Links to one or more LegalPerson entities.
